tool_definitions_snapshot.description: Search customers. Search the given name or email once. If an action remains ambiguous, ask immediately after the results; do not enumerate subscriptions, invoices, orders, or shipments before clarifying.
tool_definitions_snapshot.name: search_customers

schema.description: Customer name or email text only.

tool_definitions_snapshot.description: Get customer by ID. Use an exact cus_ ID directly. After NOT_FOUND with a suggested replacement ID, call this tool once with that replacement. A successful read completes lookup unless the user explicitly requested a later operation.
tool_definitions_snapshot.name: get_customer

schema.description: Exact cus_ customer identifier, including a replacement returned by an error.

tool_definitions_snapshot.description: Permanently delete a customer and personal data
tool_definitions_snapshot.name: delete_customer

tool_metadata.summary: Permanently delete a customer and personal data

tool_definitions_snapshot.description: List orders for a customer. List purchases for a cus_ customer ID. Use returned ord_ IDs for shipment checks; do not infer delivery state from the order record.
tool_definitions_snapshot.name: list_orders

tool_definitions_snapshot.description: Get an order by ID. Use an exact ord_ ID. After a stale-reference error with a replacement ID, call once with the replacement. Do not ask for information already supplied by the error.
tool_definitions_snapshot.name: get_order

schema.description: Exact ord_ order identifier, including a replacement returned by an error.

tool_definitions_snapshot.description: Destructive financial action. Requires a uniquely identified order. Refund one uniquely resolved ord_ order. Never choose among ambiguous customers or purchases by list position. After success, stop unless the user explicitly requested verification.
tool_definitions_snapshot.name: refund_order

schema.description: Exact, uniquely resolved ord_ order identifier.

tool_definitions_snapshot.description: List shipments by order or delivery status. Inspect delivery state by ord_ order ID or exact status. If no shipment satisfies a conditional action, report that no action is eligible and stop; do not ask an unnecessary follow-up.
tool_definitions_snapshot.name: list_shipments

schema.description: Optional exact delivery state such as failed or delivered.

tool_metadata.summary: List shipments by order or delivery status
